## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `get_valid_roots` | `get_valid_roots(rln_account_id_hex: tstr) -> tstr` | {"depth":N,"valid_roots":[…]} — the tree's configured depth and its 32-byte lowercase-hex roots (current + non-zero history); "" on error. |
| `get_merkle_proofs` | `get_merkle_proofs(config_account_id: tstr, leaf_indices_json: tstr) -> tstr` | leaf_indices_json is a JSON array of leaf indices. |
| `register_member` | `register_member(config_account_id: tstr, payer_account_id: tstr, id_commitment_hex: tstr, rate_limit: int) -> tstr` | Idempotent on-chain registration. |
| `get_native_balance` | `get_native_balance(account_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Live NATIVE balance of account_id as a decimal STRING (u128 exceeds JSON number precision). |
| `get_membership` | `get_membership(config_account_id: tstr, id_commitment_hex: tstr) -> tstr` | Membership PDA read + lifecycle state derived from the on-chain CLOCK_50 timestamp (never local time). |
| `get_registry_bounds` | `get_registry_bounds(config_account_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Registry-declared registration bounds: the compile-time rate-limit range plus ConfigState capacity/pricing/duration fields read by offset. |
| `wallet_status` | `wallet_status() -> tstr` | Whether this module's wallet is open and usable, and which account it pays with: {"detail":s,"network":s,"payer":hex64,"ready":b, "state":"pending"¦"ready"¦"failed"}. |
| `use_network` | `use_network(reference: tstr) -> tstr` | Select the network this module's wallet talks to by the CAIP-2 reference of a `logos` registry id (lowercased), or check it against the one already chosen. |
| `get_fee_state` | `get_fee_state() -> tstr` | Since 4.2.0. |
